what: The State keeper's instrument as the garage stands it: Desert Willow's battery column at the Nov 26 plan's opening 50%, rings at its 5% and 95% limits, plan C's 24 hourly states of charge as one turn of a helix round the sleeve.

code.note: packages/world as on main (base), plus the rig named here (src/stations/_objects): the stations' own builders and frames from the frame data, with the rig's camera, or the chapter's own with its lens narrowed onto the object where the frame is a crop

render.command: packages/world: sh scripts/serve.sh <port>, then node scripts/render.mjs --port <port> --frames _objects.agent-state-keeper --out <dir> --w 1280 --h 720 --scale 2 --plates 0 --raw --repeat 2
render.gpu: ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M1 Max

png_1280.size: 1280 x 720, render.mjs's Lanczos from the master

png_640.size: 640 x 360, ffmpeg's Lanczos from the master

rerender_when: the garage's battery column (stations/garage/bays.ts socColumn, kit/hedge/fields.ts makeColumn), the rig, or the frame data changes

loop.what: The same picture with the camera swung 8 degrees round the object and back over 4 s, played over the still while its card is hovered or focused.
loop.command: packages/world: sh scripts/serve.sh <port>, then node scripts/spin.mjs --port <port> --frame _objects.agent-state-keeper --name agent-state-keeper-loop --out <dir> --w 960 --h 540 --scale 2 --seconds 4 --fps 30 --swing 8 --formats mp4
loop.shot: 1920 x 1080 device px a frame, Lanczos to 960 x 540
loop.gpu: ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M1 Max
